lead_with.title: Chiral building blocks for degraders
lead_with.text: Degraders such as bexobrutideg are large, multi-part molecules with stereocentres in ligands and linkers. Offer **biocatalytic routes (ketoreductases, transaminases, esterases/lipases, kinetic resolution)** to chiral intermediates — cleaner, greener and cheaper at scale. This is a CMC conversation, so ask Stefan who owns chemical development.

lead_with.title: Phase 3 + Roche = commercial process
lead_with.text: With a ~620-patient Phase 3 and a Roche partnership, Nurix must lock a **robust, scalable commercial route** and second-source key intermediates. Enzymicals offers route scouting and scale-up **from mg to ton** alongside existing CDMOs.

lead_with.title: Proteins for Stefan's own work
lead_with.text: For his team: **tailor-made recombinant protein expression** and enzyme engineering as a service — e.g. hard-to-express proteins, tool enzymes, or protein variants for structural and assay work. Low-cost, project-based.

person.name: Stefan Gajewski

He is the depositing author of Nurix's **BTK crystal structures** in the Protein Data Bank (e.g. PDB 8GC7, 1.9 Å X-ray, protein expressed in insect cells), and a co-author of Nurix's key BTK-degrader papers: NRX-0492 in *Blood* (2023), NX-2127 in *Science* and *J. company.text: Nurix Therapeutics discovers and develops **small-molecule protein degraders** and E3 ligase modulators for cancer and immune diseases, using its DNA-encoded library (DEL) platform. Lead drug **bexobrutideg (NX-5948)**, an oral BTK degrader, is in a pivotal Phase 2 (DAYBreak CLL-201) and a Phase 3 head-to-head versus pirtobrutinib (DAYBreak CLL-306). In **June 2026 Roche** signed a global co-development deal for bexobrutideg (**$700M upfront**, ~$2.3B milestones; 40/60 cost split; 50/50 US profit share). Partnered research with **Sanofi** (STAT6 degrader in Phase 1), **Gilead** (IRAK4 degrader GS-6791, Phase 1) and **Pfizer**. Leadership: Arthur Sands (CEO), Gwenn Hansen (CSO), **Pasit Phiasivongsa (CTO, leads CMC/technical operations)**, Hans van Houte (CFO). Sites: San Francisco Bay Area and The Woodlands, TX (medicinal chemistry). Current hiring includes Associate Director Chemical Engineering, Director Pharmaceutical Development and Regulatory CMC (small molecules) — a CMC build-out for late-phase.

financials.text: **Listing:** Nasdaq: NRIX. **Fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026):** revenue **$673.1M** (vs $7.9M a year earlier), of which $653.2M Roche license revenue and $10M Sanofi milestone. **Net income:** $549.8M ($4.73/diluted share) vs net loss of $86.4M a year earlier — a one-off driven by the Roche upfront; underlying R&D spend $79.3M in the quarter. **Cash & investments:** ~**$1.1B** (vs $592.9M at Nov 30, 2025). **Runway:** into the second half of 2029. Nurix is well funded and paying 40% of bexobrutideg development — budget exists for process optimisation and supply security.

industry.title: Degraders reach late-stage CMC
industry.text: Protein degraders are moving into Phase 3 and big-pharma deals. Their size and stereochemistry make routes long and costly — the area where **biocatalysis** cuts steps, solvents and cost of goods.

industry.title: Green chemistry in pharma process
industry.text: Big pharma partners like Roche push sustainable manufacturing (PMI targets). Enzymatic steps are a standard lever for chiral amines, alcohols and resolutions — matching Enzymicals' ICP of pharma wanting greener synthesis.

talking_points: Congratulations on the Roche deal and Phase 3 start — how is the team's structural work shifting now that bexobrutideg is late-stage?
Who leads **chemical development / process chemistry** for bexobrutideg and NX-1607 — would you be open to a short intro?
Does your group ever struggle to **express or purify** a protein (kinases, ligases, tool enzymes)? Enzymicals runs tailor-made expression as a service.
Are any degrader intermediates (chiral amines, alcohols, linkers) made by classical resolution or chiral chromatography today? Enzymes can often replace those steps.
Will Nurix attend **ASH (Dec 2026)** or other US meetings where David or the team could meet? (to be confirmed)
